title: Cell structure of the walking coherent module weight
statement:
Use simplicial sets and nerves of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the ordinal-sum conventions of [def-coef-coherent-monad-modules]. Let $\Delta_+$ be the category of finite ordered sets, including the empty set, and monotone maps. Let $\Delta_\infty$ be the category of nonempty finite ordered sets and monotone maps preserving the last element. Put $D=N(\Delta_+)$ and $W=N(\Delta_\infty)$. Ordinal sum gives $D$ a simplicial monoid structure with empty unit and $W$ a left simplicial $D$-action. Regard $D$ itself as its regular left module. The map $j:D\to W$, given by adjoining a last singleton and extending each ordinal map by the identity on that singleton, is $D$-equivariant and bijective on vertices.

In the category of left simplicial $D$-modules, both $\varnothing\to W$ and $j:D\to W$ are small relative projective cell complexes. This means small transfinite composites, continuous at limit ordinals, of pushouts of coproducts of free-module maps
$$D\times\partial\Delta^n\longrightarrow D\times\Delta^n.$$
Both cell complexes permit $n\geq0$. In particular $W$ is a cellular weight for the one-object simplicial category with endomorphism simplicial monoid $D$.
